comparison.objective: Tamp coffee level in a portafilter and bayonet-lock it into an espresso group head; candidate adjusts a damper collar and locks its setting with a setscrew.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires bimanual leveling and tamping, then axial alignment, upward insertion, and bayonet rotation. Candidate requires recessed hex-key manipulation, fine collar rotation under counterhold, force-limited locking, and iterative dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires ≥6 mm tamp depth under pose constraints, portafilter alignment, 35–60° lock rotation, and release. Candidate requires verified repeated stopping behavior, no bottoming/hard-stop event, and post-lock setting retention.
comparison.reason: Rotation and locking are generic shared primitives. PR tests material compaction followed by bayonet assembly; the candidate tests continuous adjustment, screw retention, and measured energy absorption. Candidate numeric rebound, overload, and drift tolerances remain missing.
